protocol.architecture: Leaf32 block inverse + P1 (group-of-four-leaves inverse + P2 top inverse P2T) P1T. Local QR width8. Entire principal-core architecture replaced.
protocol.candidates: Constant plus7 vectors. Current uses last3 B0-preconditioned residuals after common4-step prefix + last4 of fixed7 Gaussian vectors; random uses all7 same Gaussian vectors. Filter applies3 steps I−omega B0 A to7 candidates, constant unfiltered. P2 restricts the same8 candidate vectors through P1T.
protocol.omega: Free exact largest eigenvalue of generalized(A,blockdiag(Aleaf)); omega=1/largest, identical branches. Not a paid production estimator.
protocol.cost: Optimistic kernel passes: leaf setup, prefix4, filter3 width7 passes, one full kernel assembly pass, postrestart scalariterations, reconstruction residual andfinal verification charged. Dense eig/assembly arithmetic/free periteration true checks excluded; RHS work counted separately. No native CPU/memory claim.
